description: Account-anchored invalidation fired when a reporting obligation or configuration health state transitions in either direction — including purely clock-driven waiting-to-delayed and delayed-to-action_required transitions that no positive doorbell announces, and recovery back to healthy or complete. Valid in every reporting tier including Core: it names no destination or materialization. The payload is an invalidation signal carrying identifiers, the new health, and stable issue ids — never report rows or credentials. Receivers repair every fire, missed fire, and duplicate through get_reporting_status; push is optional in every tier and polling remains the authoritative recovery path.

examples.description: Clock-driven transition to delayed with a stable issue id

ext.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
ext.title: Extension Object

feed_purpose.description: Operational use of an independently scheduled and reconciled feed. pacing is the fast snapshot path; billing requires official revisions and consumer reconciliation. Event-level exposure is intentionally deferred until a privacy and authorization contract exists.
feed_purpose.title: Reporting Feed Purpose

health.description: The health state after this transition.

enumDescriptions.action_required: A delivery, SLA, retry, or immediate readable-evidence receipt-reconciliation boundary was crossed and at least one structured human action is supplied.
enumDescriptions.complete: The queried scope is closed, retained coverage is complete, and every obligation has its configured required finality plus a verified readable materialization.
enumDescriptions.delayed: At least one obligation is late but remains within the seller's declared automated recovery path, or — for a caller-scoped Reliable Reporting view only — an authenticated consumer's received status was made stale by a seller restatement and is still inside its bounded re-read grace window. In the second case nothing is late; treat the two causes separately when building a seller-lateness SLA view, and read issues[].code to tell them apart.
enumDescriptions.healthy: Due obligations in the queried active scope are current and automated delivery is working.
enumDescriptions.waiting: No obligation in the queried active scope is due yet.

health.title: Reporting Health

idempotency_key.description: Sender-generated key stable across retries of the same fire. Sellers MUST generate a cryptographically random value (UUID v4 recommended) per distinct fire and reuse it on every retry. Receivers MUST dedupe by this key, scoped to the authenticated sender identity.

issue_ids.description: Stable identifiers of the open issues that caused or survived this transition, matching issues[].issue_id on get_reporting_status, so consumers can project AdCP reporting issues into durable work items. Empty or absent on recovery transitions.

notification_id.description: Stable per logical health transition; re-emissions reuse it, and a later distinct transition receives a new id.

previous_health.description: Operational health for an explicitly echoed reporting scope. Aggregate precedence is action_required, delayed, then healthy. waiting applies only when no active obligation is due. action_required also applies immediately when a readable consumer-receipt revision or adjustment lacks an accepted current receipt; Reliable Reporting defines no separate receipt SLA. complete applies only when the queried scope is closed, retained coverage is complete, and every obligation has its configured required finality plus a verified readable materialization.

In the second case nothing is late; treat the two causes separately when building a seller-lateness SLA view, and read issues[].code to tell them apart.

title: Reporting Status Changed Webhook

x-adcp-validation.waived_mismatch_transition: When an exact bilateral CONSUMER_STATUS_MISMATCH waiver removes the last impairment and restores underlying seller health, this is a recovery health transition. A seller advertising reporting.status_changed MUST fire it after the recovered projection is readable, with health set to healthy or complete, previous_health set to delayed or action_required, and issue_ids empty or absent. If another impairment keeps health unchanged, no reporting.status_changed fire is required; polling get_reporting_status remains authoritative.
